summary:
**MARS GUARDIAN – Project Summary**

MARS GUARDIAN is a mission-planning concept designed to help researchers identify and compare potential exploration areas on Mars. It brings different types of scientific information together in a layered map, including terrain elevation and slope, water ice indicators, temperature, and dust conditions.

The project addresses the challenge of evaluating Martian locations by making complex scientific datasets easier to view and compare in one place. Users can switch between information layers and examine different candidate areas from multiple perspectives. This approach helps mission teams better understand environmental conditions, terrain difficulties, and potential resources before planning exploration missions.

MARS GUARDIAN is important because successful Mars exploration requires more than simply choosing a location. Understanding the conditions of that location is essential. Our goal is to make scientific information more accessible, support better-informed decisions, and contribute to safer and more effective future Mars exploration.
details:
MARS GUARDIAN – Project Details

MARS GUARDIAN is a mission-planning concept designed to help researchers evaluate and compare potential exploration areas on Mars. It brings different scientific data together in a layered map, including terrain elevation and slope, water ice indicators, temperature, and dust conditions.

The system is designed to allow users to turn information layers on and off and examine the same location from different perspectives. By comparing multiple factors together, mission teams can better understand the advantages and challenges of different candidate areas.

The main benefit of MARS GUARDIAN is that it makes complex scientific information easier to understand and compare. Its intended impact is to support more informed mission planning and contribute to future Mars exploration.

Our project is based on open scientific data sources, including NASA's Mars Exploration Program, NASA's Planetary Data System, and the USGS Astrogeology Science Center. We developed our project as a presentation-based concept using visual map designs and information layers. The presentation was prepared using digital presentation tools. A fully functional software application or connected live-data system has not yet been developed.

The creative aspect of MARS GUARDIAN is its approach of combining different scientific factors into one organized visual system. Our team considered terrain difficulty, possible water ice resources, environmental conditions, data accessibility, and the needs of future exploration missions.
